gaps.needs: For odd prime p and even n,n′≥2 congruent modulo p−1 with p−1∤n, B_n/n and B_n′/n′ are p-integral and congruent modulo p.
For odd prime p and 1≤k≤(p−3)/2, the direct-Artin χ^(1−2k) component of the mod-p class group of ℚ(μ_p) is nonzero exactly when p divides num(B_(2k)).
For the direct Artin action, the trivial and χ mod-p class components vanish and every even a satisfies dim A_a ≤ dim A_(1−a) ≤ dim A_a+1.
For totally real F and k≥1, the ℓ-valuation of |ζ_F(1−2k)| equals that of the finite continuous H²/H¹ order ratio in twist 2k for every odd ℓ, and also for ℓ=2 when F/ℚ is abelian.
